Frequently Asked Questions

01

What is a faceless video?

A faceless video is a video that does not show the creator's face or identity. Instead, it uses visuals like images, animations, stock footage, or AI-generated content, along with voiceovers or text, to convey information or tell a story. Faceless videos are popular for YouTube, TikTok, and other platforms because they allow creators to remain anonymous while still producing engaging content.
02

What is a faceless video generator?

A faceless video generator is an AI-powered tool that helps you create videos without showing your face or revealing your identity. It automatically generates visuals, voiceovers, and scripts based on your input or chosen topic. With a faceless video generator like Blipix, you can easily produce engaging content for platforms like YouTube and TikTok, even if you don't want to appear on camera.
03

How does it work?

Blipix.pro uses AI to help you create, customize, and schedule videos. Simply choose your topic, customize the details like art style, voiceover, and music, and our AI will generate a unique video for you. You can review and edit the video before posting, and once you're ready, connect your channels and let Blipix.pro automatically handle the publishing process according to your schedule.
04

What are credits?

One video generation costs 10 credits. Our AI models automatically generate images for your videos by default. However, there may be times when the generated images don't meet your expectations, and you might want to create replacements. Any remaining credits allow you to generate new images. Your plan includes a set number of credits that reset every 30 days, but if you need more, you can easily purchase additional credits.
05

Can I monetize my videos?

Yes, absolutely! All videos created with Blipix.pro can be monetized on platforms like YouTube and TikTok without any issues. You retain full commercial rights to your content.
06

Are videos unique and license-free?

Yes, all videos created with Blipix.pro are unique and license-free. You have full ownership of the content and can use it as you wish.
07

How long are the videos?

You can create videos up to 10 minutes long! Choose from short-form (under 60 seconds), medium (1-2 minutes), or long-form (up to 10 minutes) depending on your content strategy.
08

Are all music tracks copyright-free and platform compliant?

Yes, all music tracks available in Blipix.pro are 100% copyright-free and comply with YouTube and TikTok content guidelines. You can safely use them in your videos without worrying about copyright claims.
09

Which platforms do you support?

Blipix.pro currently supports auto-posting to YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram. Simply connect your accounts and your videos will be automatically published according to your schedule.
10

Is there a discount for annual subscriptions?

Yes, we offer 4 months free if you choose the annual plan.
11

Does Blipix have an affiliate program?

Yes, we do! By joining the Blipix affiliate program through your account dashboard, you'll earn a 30% commission on all payments made by customers you refer!
12

How secure is my data and content when using your AI software?

We care a lot about keeping your data safe and private. We protect all your information and content carefully. We use strong security to make sure no one can access your data without permission.
13

Can I change my plan at any time?

Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time.
14

When will I be billed?

You will be billed at the start of your subscription.
15

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can easily cancel your subscription at any time by going to your account settings.
